assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: full-width hero photograph for an Indonesian institute profile website about cities, citizens, clear thinking and collective progress. Wide 16:9 street-level composition, adults walking home from work, modest food stalls and a fruit seller, a woman in a muted teal hijab, people from different generations, cyclists in the distance, old neighborhood shopfronts with modern towers softly visible far behind, leafy shade and lived-in details. People naturally interacting and moving, no posing, nobody looking at camera, no staged corporate event. Main foreground figures and stall toward outer thirds, center retains visual breathing room for a large centered website headline. Authentic contemporary Indonesian city atmosphere, humid soft sunlight, film-like rich dark petrol teal shadows and warm golden highlights, realistic skin, restrained saturation, sophisticated editorial photography, optimistic human dignity. Do not make the entire scene artificially teal. No legible signage, no added words or graphics, no logo, no political banners, no watermarks. Image only, no website mockup. This is an illustrative city scene.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: editorial feature image for Institut Cakra Nala's website section on algorithmic ethics and society. One beautiful landscape 4:3 image visualizing algorithms shaping collective urban life WITHOUT ANY humans, faces, heads, portraits, bodies, silhouettes, hands, avatars or humanoid forms. A sophisticated elevated view of a dense Indonesian city with low tiled-roof neighborhoods, civic buildings, trees and a few modern towers, represented as a highly detailed architectural scale model in warm ivory and dark petrol teal. Fine restrained champagne-gold illuminated network paths travel along streets connecting neighborhood blocks, a few luminous decision nodes and subtle translucent layered paths hovering over the city indicate information selection and algorithmic influence. The city remains tangible and human-scale even though no people appear. Composition focuses on interconnected neighborhoods, strong central diagonal flow, calm negative space in upper left, refined depth of field, realistic architectural miniature materials, soft cinematic daylight and warm glints, not a neon sci-fi metropolis. Palette #07545B teal, #082F34 deep teal, #D8AC50 muted gold, warm ivory. Premium thoughtful institutional editorial artwork, not a sales dashboard or generic AI stock graphic. No letters, no readable text, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no brains, no robot faces, no human anatomy. Output image only.

notes: The hero and all content photos use original Aksi Indonesia assets. The algorithm-and-society visual is now a code-authored Remotion composition. Generated scene artwork is archived and not rendered; only the logo extraction remains in use.
